title: What's new
subtitle: Every Kolo release — from the first version to today.

footer.title: Have an idea for Kolo?
footer.subtitle: Tell us what you're missing — we read every message.

versions.title: Orbits, capsules and a course for every language
versions.intro: The biggest Kolo update yet. Daily flames have made way for weekly orbits, practising now earns you rewards, and every language gets its own course.

features.title: A course for every language
features.text: Norwegian over here, Spanish over there: each course has its own sets and folders, so nothing gets mixed up. Pick your language once and switch courses right from the header.

features.title: Weekly orbits
features.text: Instead of flames that go out after a single missed day, you get a weekly goal of 3 to 7 days. Hit it and your orbit closes and your streak grows. A shield covers a rough week, and a broken streak can be repaired in the first three days of the next one.

features.title: XP and levels
features.text: Every session and game earns XP, and your level grows with it. If you practised before, the XP for every card you've studied is already yours.

features.title: Capsules and collections
features.text: New levels and closed orbits bring capsules. Inside: satellites, ring colours, profile backgrounds and titles — 36 items across four collections. Duplicates turn into stardust, and stardust turns into a shield or a missing item. The odds are right there in the capsule window.

features.title: A brand-new profile
features.text: Your avatar in the ring of your choice, your level, your weekly orbit, a showcase of your three favourite rewards, medals and stats — all on one page. The higher your level, the more satellites fit on your orbit — up to three.

features.title: Thank you, beta testers
features.text: Everyone who joins before the end of 2026 gets a medal, the Beta Tester title and the First Orbit ring. After that, they're gone for good.

features.title: Settings that make sense
features.text: Account, appearance, learning, notifications and data — in short rows, like the settings on your phone, so you can see what's on at a glance. Email, password, sign-out, backup and account deletion live there too, in More → Settings. And the Other tab is now called More.

fixes: Progress is now counted by the server, so it can't get lost or faked.
A session done offline no longer disappears — it counts as soon as Kolo is back online.
The new Orbit design and a new heading font.
Writing to support is simpler: pick a topic, type your message, and we'll reply to your account email. Messages with characters like _ or * now send without an error.
New here? A short intro and First steps on the home screen take you from your first set to your first session — with hints along the way.
The home screen no longer says everything is reviewed while new words are waiting, and a set's page now has a Study button.

Folders work properly: rename and recolour them, delete only after a confirmation (the sets stay), the Back button closes a folder, and after a session you return to the same folder. You can create a folder straight from a set’s menu, and starred sets from folders show up in Favourites.

versions.title: Kolo on your home screen
versions.intro: You can now install Kolo like an app, and there are three games for quick review.

features.title: Install Kolo
features.text: Add Kolo to your phone's home screen or your computer's dock: it opens full screen, without an address bar, and updates itself.

features.title: Three games
features.text: Speed Round — answer as many as you can, with a streak multiplier for right answers. Survival — three lives, each mistake costs one. Match — pair words with their translations before time runs out.

features.title: Profile photos from your device
features.text: No more hunting for a link: pick a photo from your phone or computer and Kolo compresses it for you.

features.title: Your own @username
features.text: Every account now has a unique username. You can change it in your profile.

features.title: Tighter on phones
features.text: Home, Profile and Other are much more compact: fewer giant cards, more of what matters on screen. The activity calendar fits your screen and achievements fold into a short list.

fixes: The back of a flashcard no longer overlaps the front.
The mobile browser toolbar no longer covers buttons at the bottom of the screen.
Pages you open often appear instantly, without extra animation.
The My words / Kolo Sets switch now spans the full width on phones.
Sets no longer disappear when you delete a folder.
The daily game no longer gets confused by time zones, and emails no longer show on the leaderboard.
Daily reminders move to the next day correctly.

versions.title: Hello, newcomers
versions.intro: A welcome tour for first-timers and two new interface languages.

features.title: App tour
features.text: Six short steps with live previews show you the essentials the first time you open Kolo. You can take the tour again any time.

features.title: Norwegian and Ukrainian
features.text: Kolo now speaks Norwegian 🇳🇴 and Ukrainian 🇺🇦: every screen, session, setting and more than 130 tips.

features.title: Streak celebration
features.text: When your streak grows, Kolo throws a little fireworks show.

fixes: Finishing a session counts the day towards your streak again.

versions.title: Neater everywhere

features.title: Polished design
features.text: We tightened spacing, type and the order of things on every screen — everything is easier to read.

features.title: New set cards
features.text: Set cards are easier to scan and quicker to open.

fixes: Navigation and layout on Home and Profile are tidier.

versions.title: A new Home
versions.intro: We rebuilt the navigation: words have their own section, and Home is now your personal dashboard.

features.title: The Words section
features.text: All your sets and cards live in their own section, so they're easier to manage.

features.title: Home
features.text: Your daily goal, key stats and a quick way back into review — everything you need when you open Kolo.

features.title: Ready-made sets by level
features.text: The library now has Kolo sets from beginner to advanced, with more on the way.

features.title: A fresh look
features.text: We refreshed the design of the whole app.

versions.title: A short pause for safety
versions.intro: During a routine check we found a weak spot in our server configuration, and our host briefly stopped Kolo to keep your data safe. We reviewed all our protections, fixed the configuration and brought Kolo back. Your data is fine.

versions.title: Talk to us
versions.intro: Support is here, and adding words got easier.

features.title: Support
features.text: Found a bug or have an idea? Write to us right from the app — your message goes straight to the Kolo team.

features.title: A new card import
features.text: The import window is simpler, and an AI help button shows you how to prepare your word list.

features.title: A cleaner design
features.text: The interface looks cleaner and more modern.

fixes: An achievement you've earned no longer shows as locked.
